question: Complete the verb forms in the passage below:
passage: The shop ________ (be) tiny and dark. I ________ (enter) cautiously, noticing that a layer of dust ________ (settle) on every surface. passage: The vase ________ (lie) in pieces on the floor. The cat ________ (jump) onto the shelf a moment ago. If Rahul ________ (be) careful, he ________ (not break) it. His mother ________ (buy) it years ago. He ________ (try) to glue it back when she ________ (enter) the room. He ________ (scold) for his carelessness. He promised ________ (replace) it soon.
explanation: Past narrative: (0) lay - example; (1) had jumped - past perfect; (2) had been - past perfect in conditional; (3) would not have broken - conditional perfect; (4) had bought - past perfect; (5) was trying - past continuous; (6) entered - past simple; (7) was scolded - past passive; (8) to replace - infinitive.

question: Complete the verb forms in the passage below:
passage: The rocket ________ (take) off at 9:00 AM. It ________ (carry) five astronauts to the moon. They ________ (train) for this mission for a decade. Had the engine ________ (fail), the mission ________ (abort). While ________ (orbit) the Earth, they saw a spectacular view. They ________ (land) on the lunar surface by Friday. No sooner ________ they ________ (touch) down than they ________ (plant) the flag.
explanation: Complex tenses: (0) took - example; (1) was carrying - past continuous; (2) had been training - past perfect continuous; (3) failed - past simple in inverted conditional; (4) would have been aborted - conditional perfect passive; (5) orbiting - gerund; (6) will land - future simple; (7-8) had...touched - inverted past perfect; (9) planted - past simple.

question: Complete the verb forms in the passage below:
passage: The mansion ________ (stand) empty for years. Locals ________ (claim) that it ________ (haunt). If anyone ________ (enter) at night, they ________ (see) strange lights. The windows ________ (shatter) during the last storm. We ________ (advise) to stay away. I wish the owner ________ (sell) it earlier. Now, it ________ (renovate) by a group of architects.
explanation: Mixed tenses: (0) had been standing - example; (1) claim - present simple; (2) is haunted - present passive; (3) enters - present simple in conditional; (4) will see - future simple; (5) were shattered - past passive; (6) were advised - past passive; (7) had sold - past perfect in wish; (8) is being renovated - present continuous passive.
